balanced.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Produce a new MEDIUM-DETAIL LOW-POLY 3D art-direction reference exactly BETWEEN the two supplied detail extremes. Input 1 is TOO COARSE and flat; input 2 is TOO DETAILED and polished. Input 3 is the user's original screenshot for the gritty autumn racing atmosphere. Keep the scene composition and believable scale from inputs 1 and 2. Aim for restrained early-2000s game environment fidelity: angular readable architecture, selected low-poly faceting, natural proportions, modest slightly worn texture detail. Serious grounded atmosphere, not cute or toy-like. Starting from input 1, restore a measured amount of architectural detail and material definition, while staying clearly simpler than input 2. Important balance: broad planar building surfaces with sparse low-contrast masonry/seam patterns and localized grime; road with a subtle matte rough texture and a few broad repairs, not the huge flat polygon color patches of input 1 and not the fine cracks or photographic noise of input 2. Medium-complexity foliage with irregular broken crown silhouettes formed by many small angular leaf clumps, visible branch gaps, natural tree proportions; neither coarse crystalline rock-shaped crowns nor individual detailed leaves. Moderate geometric detail in curb joints, repeated railings, building openings and large roof beams; omit tiny bolts, scratches, intricate trim and clutter. Rocks remain broad angular forms with restrained color/shading transitions. Use simple physically plausible soft shading and a naturally CLOUDY sky with gentle continuous cloud forms, not flat polygon sky patches. Muted ochre/russet foliage, gray/beige concrete, deep blue-gray shadows, warm overcast afternoon sunlight. Dry rough materials, restrained sunlight contrast and modest atmospheric haze. Car has realistic smooth main body curvature with simplified supporting detail, simple five-spoke wheels, modest paint reflections, clear rear wing; more detailed than a blockout and less glossy/detailed than a promotional render. No exaggerated rounded shapes, miniature proportions, cel outlines, voxel forms, photographic microdetail, bloom, lens flare, dramatic golden-hour polish, depth of field or motion blur. Crisp still scene usable by coding agents studying modeling/material choices. ONE wide 16:9 full-frame scene with no HUD, text, annotations, collage or watermark. Scene: elevated diagonal view across S-curved coastal road to lighthouse with drivable base passage, harbor skyline and ocean. Restore moderate stone-panel seams, a handful of tower openings and simple lantern railings, keep the tower visibly slightly faceted. Use medium-complexity natural autumn crowns, large angular rock bank forms and muted slate-blue water with only subtle broad ripples and soft reflections, no glitter trail, foam or detailed waves. Keep the small E46 in the foreground for scale. Road should curve naturally rather than bend into sharp geometric corners.

coarse_comparison.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Revise the FIRST input image into a MUCH COARSER, LESS DETAILED AND LESS POLISHED low-poly 3D environment art target. First image = layout and subject to simplify; second image = user's original autumn atmosphere reference. Preserve the first image's location identity, framing, plausible proportions and route, but radically reduce modeling and material detail. This must visibly look like a modest, raw real-time 3D game render, NOT a polished modern cinematic render. Grounded, serious, slightly desolate arcade-racing setting, NOT cute, whimsical, miniature, toy-like, voxel, cartoon or chibi. Use large flat faces and visibly hard-shaded low-polygon silhouettes at human scale. Buildings: large untextured or lightly color-blocked planes, square corners, very few broad grime patches, no modeled individual bricks, no corrugation micro-ribs, no elaborate trim, no photographic texture maps. Ground: almost-flat charcoal/earth surfaces with only a few big low-contrast patches; no tiny cracks, pebbles, aggregate, individual blades of grass, scattered detailed leaves or fine dirt texture. Foliage: sparse irregular angular polygon clusters with flat ochre/brown faces on exposed coarse branching trunks; absolutely no individually identifiable leaves. Cylinders: clearly 8-12-sided. Rocks: large sharp flat polygon faces. Fences: simplified sparse bars or a subdued simple coarse mesh, no finely rendered wire pattern. Lights: broad simple diffuse warm afternoon light and muted cool shadow; no dramatic cinematic glow, lens effects, photoreal reflections, glossy wet surfaces, bloom, depth of field, film grain, ambient-occlusion-heavy contact detail or excessive color grading. Muted mustard/russet autumn colors with gray/beige architecture. Cars: recognizable angular realistic-size E46 race coupe, dark blue/silver broad body panels, simplified wheels as dark low-sided cylinders with simple hubs, rear wing as rectangular bars; no detailed wheel spokes, badges, plate lettering, engine parts or slick promotional-car shading. Remain crisp and legible with believable topology and substantial architecture. Reduce fine detail in EVERY region of the image, not just background. ONE wide 16:9 full-frame scene; no HUD, text, title, legend, collage, callouts or watermark. Specific scene: elevated diagonal view of the S-shaped coastal causeway and lighthouse. Lighthouse becomes a simple hard-shaded octagonal tapered shaft with a broad dark horizontal band, a blocky passage base and a minimal lantern cap. Seawalls are rectangular masses, harbor skyline is a few plain extruded boxes, cranes are simplified large beam silhouettes. Ocean must be a near-flat slate-blue surface with only a few broad polygon-color patches, no waves, foam, glitter or sun reflection trail. Rock banks use a small number of big angular forms. Small car front three-quarter foreground for scale. Preserve the open coastal composition; greatly simplify everything visible.
